entries.title: Psalms 149:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.

entries.title: Psalms 149:2
segments: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

entries.title: Psalms 149:3
segments: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.

entries.title: Psalms 149:4
segments: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
segments: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.

entries.title: Psalms 149:6
segments: [Let] the high praises of God [be] in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;

entries.title: Psalms 149:7
segments: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;

entries.title: Psalms 149:8
segments: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
segments: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.
